input_validation.disorder: All assembly/group values dot; no split/disordered site declared. This does not prove absence of unmodeled disorder.
input_validation.H_model: 11 H sites present; calculated/riding coordinates, five CH and two rotating methyl groups. Original X-ray model retained; no neutron normalization applied.
input_validation.ADP: 16 anisotropic non-H sites and 11 isotropic H; original uncertainties/flags retained.
anomalies: One fractional coordinate is negative; kept as source periodic representation, not invalid or wrapped.
H sites are constrained/model-derived, not independently refined nuclear positions.
No new experimental authentication against live CCDC: user-supplied deposition metadata, DOI/cell/composition and independent SI agree; original download URL unrecorded.

historical_boundary: Prior integrity repair and audit files remain time-specific and unchanged. Current source-input status in this record supersedes their missing-CIF claim; it does not retroactively alter their conclusions.
scope_note: No change to question, weights, substantive evidence standards or AR method freedom. PR attachments only disclose the source.

input_check.scope: Static stereochemical input identity, using supplied coordinates. No interaction or new reference computed.

source_tabulated_torsion.kind: already tabulated CIF value, not recomputed

input_check.CIP_reason: At C9(map7), carbonyl C11(map5) has O/O/O neighbor sequence, higher priority than C10(map2) with N/N/C. At C8(map8), aryl C5(map9) outranks H8(map20). The source geometry places those higher-priority substituents on the same side.
input_check.source_name_boundary: Article pp1 and4 name (E); original source and its geometry are preserved. Observed deposited crystal governs this task; nomenclature mismatch is disclosed, not repaired by moving atoms.

stereochemistry_correction.historical_evidence_reuse: Inspect the actual geometry and mapping of each E-labelled historical calculation. No automatic reuse as this Z source crystal; no old monomer result certifies packing.
